description: Find AI agents, MCP servers and agent tools that do a job. Describe the task in plain words (e.g. 'reply to customer emails for a dental clinic'). Optional filters narrow by industry, type, price, setup and integration. Results come from the AgentExplorio index with verification labels; unverified listings are labeled.

industry.description: Industry slug to filter by, e.g. legal, healthcare, ecommerce-retail

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1 to 20)

query.description: The task in plain words, e.g. 'book appointments for a hair salon'

setup.description: no_code for tools anyone can set up; developer for tools that need coding or API keys

type.description: Kind of listing: agent (does the task on its own), assistant (chat helper), mcp_tool (MCP server an AI can call), builder_tool (platform to build agents), workflow_template (ready-made automation)

verified_only.description: true to return only listings AgentExplorio has verified

works_with.description: An app or protocol the result must integrate with, e.g. Slack, HubSpot, WhatsApp, MCP

name: search_agents
title: Search AI agents
